endonym.gloss: the thing that keeps it warm away from a body

description.value: A double-walled vessel of cut rind and worked stone, made to hold a chemosynthetic starter at body temperature away from a body for the length of a walk to the margin. The inner chamber is packed against the outer with dried mat and closes on a tapered rind stopper; loaded, it holds within two degrees for about nine hours in still air and considerably less in wind. Warmers are personal, are never lent, and are cut open and discarded when the strain they carried is retired, which is why intact examples do not exist. This one was cut open in the ordinary way and both halves were handed over together with the strain record.
